title: oceanic rich and shattering Mexican uni Tacos
description: Rich, shattering, energizing mexican dish featuring uni, ferment-jang, anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients, served on a cedar plank.

ingredients.name: Uni (sea urchin)
ingredients.notes: Fresh, high-quality uni is essential for this dish.

ingredients.name: Ferment-Jang (Korean chili paste)
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores or online.

instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent it from burning during cooking.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Rinse the uni under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the uni with salt and black pepper.
Brush the cedar plank with avocado oil and place the uni on top.
Grill the uni for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred and still tender.
Meanwhile, mix the ferment-jang with lime juice in a small bowl.
Brush the mix onto the uni during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the uni from the grill and garnish with cilantro, cucumber, and radish.
Serve immediately, with lime wedges and crushed red pepper flakes on the side.
Garnish with microgreens for added flavor and nutrition.
